title: Collectibles V1 — Trusted Personal Vault (factory-3)
notes: Founder: factory-3 is Collectibles, not overlay. Overlay stays factory-1/2.
Manufacture from MASTER_BLUEPRINT + SCHEMA_CONTRACTS. No invention of parallel MarketplaceCard identities.
MTG cataloger modules are bootstrap adapters — generalize behind CategoryAdapter.

steps.title: CategoryAdapter interface module
steps.intent: Export createCategoryAdapterRegistry and a documented CategoryAdapter contract (identify, resolveIdentity, price, conditionSchema) used by TwinService. MTG must register later; do not hard-code Magic in this file.

steps.title: CollectibleTwin service foundation
steps.intent: Create Twin create/update helpers with representation_level 1-4, needs_review, identity_status enums from SCHEMA_CONTRACTS. Ownership/possession/custody/location must remain separate concepts (do not collapse). No MarketplaceCard type.

steps.title: MTG CategoryAdapter wrapping existing vision/pricing
steps.intent: Implement MTG adapter that imports/calls existing services/mtg-card-vision.js and services/mtg-card-pricing.js behind CategoryAdapter.identify/price. Unresolved printing → needs_review reasons. Do not duplicate Scryfall logic.

steps.title: Collectibles capture/list routes scaffold
steps.intent: Register /api/v1/collectibles twin capture + list stubs per API_CONTRACTS (auth reuse LifeOS). Wire twin-service + mtg adapter. Export registerCollectiblesRoutes.

steps.title: V1 adapter+twin reachability acceptance test
steps.intent: node:test that imports category-adapter, twin-service, mtg-adapter, and asserts routes file calls twin-service (reachability, not exports-only).
